eps.t: Even High School Boys Have Their Holes… / Ume Takes Responsibility
eps.ov: Ume Mizunoe joins the student council so he doesn't have to repeat a year, but everyone there has such unique personalities. He nervously starts working there and gets thrown around by the council's strong personalities!

eps.t: Savior Tan / The Seven Mysteries of the Academy and the Council’s Night Patrol / Komaro Is Here!
eps.ov: Ume drops by the student council room as he takes care of something early in the morning. He then finds a young girl covered in blood slumped over a desk! And it seems the girl has become quite attached to Ume!?

eps.t: Pool Cleaning and the Swimsuit Episode / I’m Happy for You
eps.ov: When Ume gets home, he finds a suspicious figure—who turns out to be none other than his sister, Sho Mizunoe! Sho, Arisu, and Komaro engage in a who-knows-Ume-more one-upping battle. What's going on here!?

eps.t: Komaro and Her Suggestion Box / Terui-senpai’s Secret / Koki-chan and the Light Music Club / Rendezvous in the Gym Storage Room!!
eps.ov: The student council receives a complaint from the British tea ceremony club that the nearby music club is too noisy. It's not the instruments causing the noise, but something a bit more sensual!?

eps.t: The Student Council’s Bonding Retreat!! / Operation Ume Tan-Tan! / Ume Shares His Umbrella
eps.ov: Ume and Tan sneak around to study Arisu, whose true nature remains a bit of a mystery. When they see an opening and rummage through Arisu's things, she suddenly comes back out of nowhere! What are they going to do now!?

eps.t: Lost in the Moment / Ume and Hiratsuka-sensei / A Day in Komaro’s Life
eps.ov: As a thank-you for their help, the student council joins the British tea ceremony club for one of their activities. Hisako finishes up in the restroom, and she tries to go back to her seat but is unable to open the toilet stall door!?

There's a comment in the suggestion box! After seeing the suggestion, Komaro suggests selling affordable rice balls for the students. The student council moves to fulfill Komaro's and the students' wishes!

eps.t: A Day in Satomi’s Life / Cleanup Duty and Boobs / Get Well Soon! / Ume’s Playboy Allegations / Tan’s Scheme / Cold Alone, Warm Together
eps.ov: On a cold winter day, Tan manages to fleece Ume out of some money under the pretense of giving him a hand warmer! Arisu sees this and thinks there's something more to the story, so she and Ume start to follow Tan around!

eps.t: Komaro and the Zoo / Arisu in No-Bra-Land
